snippet.title: Transport Tycoon Deluxe - Official PC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The classic tycoon experience is available now on Steam and GOG. Dive into Chris Sawyer's pre-RollerCoaster Tycoon experience and run your own transport empire. Play it today! 

Download Now: 
Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766810/Transport_Tycoon_Deluxe/
GOG:
https://www.gog.com/game/transport_tycoon_deluxe
